title: Implementar barrera durable para canaries de contención real
mission: Implement an isolated durable contention-start barrier for real GitHub portfolio pin canaries so multiple genuinely distinct /wc workers can register as entrants before any of them attempts the deterministic pin CREATE. The barrier must coordinate timing only: it must not grant execution authority, replace PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1, or require human synchronization. Add executable 2-worker and 5-worker tests and leave the mechanism candidate-scoped unless independently integrated under proper authority.
definition_of_done: A documented append-only entrant receipt schema and deterministic barrier path are implemented in isolated candidate/test scope.
Barrier release requires the fixture's declared distinct-worker contender count and never grants portfolio execution authority by itself.
After release every contender still races the exact same PORTFOLIO_PIN_PROTOCOL_V1 generation path; losers remain required to emit collision receipts and re-enter allocation.
Timeout/abandon behavior is bounded so one missing entrant cannot indefinitely trap workers; timed-out entrants return to allocation without creating a pin.
Executable tests cover 2-worker and 5-worker registration/release, duplicate worker registration, timeout, exactly-one pin winner and loser re-entry semantics.
A follow-up real-GitHub canary is materialized only if tests pass; no Current/Human Accepted/Served or production /w promotion is inferred.
